opportunities.title: Marketing Operations Co-Pilot | Virtual Assistant for Business Launch
opportunities.description: # Marketing Operations Co-Pilot | Virtual Assistant for Business Launch **Initial Project Budget:** $70 fixed price **Project Type:** Kickstart assignment with potential for long-term collaboration **Preferred Location:** Africa ## About the Opportunity We are building a growing business focused on African artisans, companies and locally made products, with both B2C and B2B audiences. We are looking for a proactive and resourceful Virtual Assistant to become a **Marketing Operations Co-Pilot**, working directly with the founder to help structure, coordinate and execute our marketing activities. This is not simply a social media posting assignment. We are looking for someone who can help turn ideas, existing materials and business priorities into consistent marketing operations. You will initially work on a small kickstart project, with the possibility of becoming a regular part of the team as the business develops. ## Initial Kickstart Project The first assignment will focus on getting our marketing operations moving. **1. Content and social media** - Review and organize existing brand materials, product information, photos and videos on Notion for the editorials then Google Drive folder for assets. - Draft social media posts with captions. - Suggest Story ideas and short-form video concepts. - Adapt communication for B2C and B2B audiences. **2. B2B and email marketing** - Prepare a B2B introduction and outreach template. - Draft an introductory newsletter. - Help organize product highlights and promotional messaging. **3. Marketing operations** - Organize marketing assets in Google Drive. - Improve our existing content-planning workflow using Notion or Google Sheets. - Prepare basic response templates for customer and business enquiries. - Establish a simple process for planning, approvals, follow-ups and tracking. **4. Coordination** - Maintain an overview of ongoing marketing tasks. - Follow up on missing information and pending actions. - Communicate progress and suggest practical improvements. - Help ensure that agreed activities move forward consistently. ## Expected Deliverables - Refining 3 month content calendar. - Social media posts ready for review. - One newsletter & Automation (we'll go through this altogether). - One B2B outreach template. - Organized marketing assets and a basic workflow. - Short handover with recommendations for the next steps. We will provide existing brand information, product materials and access to relevant tools. You will not need to visit workshops or produce original photography. ## The Person We Are Looking For - Experience in virtual assistance, marketing coordination or social media management. - Good written English; French or Arabic is a plus. - Comfortable using Canva, Google Drive and Notion or Google Sheets. - Organized, reliable and proactive. - Able to work independently and communicate clearly. - Interested in entrepreneurship, African products, crafts and emerging businesses. - Comfortable working in an evolving environment where initiative and problem-solving matter. ## Long-Term Possibility The initial assignment is a starting point, not necessarily the end goal. We want to find someone who can gradually become an integral part of our marketing operations, working alongside the founder and helping coordinate activities across content, social media, B2B communication, newsletters and campaign execution. Depending on performance, commitment, mutual fit and business growth, there may be opportunities for: - Regular paid collaboration as our Marketing Operations VA. - A full-time position within the business after an initial collaboration period. - A potential associate role with greater responsibility and involvement in the development of the business. We are particularly interested in someone who wants to grow with a business, take ownership and contribute beyond individual tasks. ## Budget and Application **Initial fixed budget: $70** Please propose a realistic scope and turnaround time for the kickstart assignment. To apply, answer these questions: 1. How would you approach the first 3 months to help us organize and kickstart our marketing operations? 2. Which tools and workflows have you used to coordinate marketing activities? 3. Can you share an example of relevant work you have completed? 4. Are you interested in growing into a long-term role, potentially full-time or as an associate, if the collaboration works well?

opportunities.title: Enhance Mitutoyo MCOSMOS Program - 07/11/2026 10:35 EST
opportunities.description: I have an existing MCOSMOS routine on a Mitutoyo CMM that needs expert attention. The part we measure is fairly intricate, full of true-position, profile, and orientation call-outs, and the current program is either missing features or flagging false deviations. My goal is to walk away with a clean, reliable routine that hits every GD&T requirement and runs without operator intervention. What I can supply: the native 3D CAD model with its drawing as well as the current MCOSMOS program and a sample part for correlation. You will be free to probe the model, compare code, and verify touch points directly on the machine (Geopak/PartManager environment). Your task is to review the existing program, correct any probing paths or alignment logic, add any missing datum checks, and validate that the results match the drawing. Once finished, I’d like the updated .prt file, any custom alignment schemes, and a short summary of changes so future edits are easy to follow. Deliverables • Revised MCOSMOS program ready to load and run • Updated alignments and probe paths for all GD&T features • Change log or brief write-up outlining what was fixed or added • Confirmation run on my sample part showing all features within tolerance If you work daily with Mitutoyo machines, MCOSMOS, Geopak, or CAT1000P and are comfortable troubleshooting complex GD&T routines, I’m ready to get started.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40807540, publicado hace 1 hora (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: INR 750 - 1,250.

opportunities.title: WhatsApp API Business Verification
opportunities.description: I need to move our existing Meta Business account all the way to “Verified” so we can finally open the WhatsApp Business API. We are a small team of freelancers in Erbil, Iraq working under one member’s legal name and, at the moment, we have no company registration, tax licence, utility bill, or bank statement in a business name. Because of that, the usual documentation path does not apply to us and the account is still sitting in an unverified state. Your job is to use your first-hand experience with Meta Business Manager, Facebook Developer Console and the WhatsApp Business Platform to: • map out exactly which sole-proprietor or personal documents Meta currently accepts in this region, • prepare and submit those files inside Business Manager, configuring every required field so the details on the documents match the profile, • handle any follow-up questions from Meta, including a possible appeal, until the green “Verified” badge appears. The work is finished when the account shows “Business verified” and the WhatsApp API phone number can be requested without additional compliance warnings.

opportunities.title: Modern Pub 3D Renderings
opportunities.description: I need photorealistic still images that capture a modern, upscale pub with an integrated dining area. The space is already designed; what’s missing are high-quality visuals that will convey the concept to investors and help finalize finish selections. I will provide floor plans, reference photos, exact furniture specifications, and a materials palette. Using that information, I expect fully lit, textured, and post-processed renders that look true to life and highlight the premium feel of the design—think sleek surfaces, sophisticated lighting, and a warm yet contemporary atmosphere. Deliverables • 4–6 high-resolution (4K) JPEG or PNG images showing key viewpoints: main bar, dining zone, entrance perspective, and one hero shot capturing the full ambience. • One round of minor revisions to tweak materials, colors, or camera angles. All work should be done in a professional 3D package (3ds Max, Blender, or similar) with V-Ray/Cycles/Corona-quality output. I’ll need both the final images and the original scene file so my team can archive the project. When sending your proposal, let me know your preferred software, estimated turnaround, and a link to at least one comparable interior render you’ve produced.

opportunities.title: Realistic 3D Product Modeling
opportunities.description: I need a photorealistic 3D model of a single fashion, cosmetic, or accessory item that will be featured in my online store and promotional materials. The model must capture the exact look and feel of the real product—including full texture, accurate materials, and true-to-life proportions—so that it can stand alone as imagery on product pages and ads. Scope of work • Build one high-fidelity model optimized for web and marketing use (glTF/GLB, FBX, or OBJ—whichever you prefer). • Provide clean UVs, PBR textures, and a minimum of four high-resolution still renders showing the product from different angles (front, back, side, and a dynamic close-up). • Lighting should be neutral studio style to keep color reproduction consistent. Acceptance criteria 1. Geometry, scale, and details match reference photos I will supply. 2. Textures remain crisp at 4K; no visible seams or stretching. 3. Final renders delivered as transparent-background PNGs plus layered source files so I can change backgrounds later. 4. Model must load smoothly in typical WebGL viewers without exceeding reasonable poly counts. Please let me know your preferred file format, any past examples of fashion or cosmetic items you have modeled, and the approximate turnaround time you can commit to once you receive my references.

opportunities.title: Accurate Blender Robot Modeling Required
opportunities.description: # Hiring: Expert Blender 3D Artist – Accurate Hard-Surface Robot Modeling **Project Type:** Fixed-price 3D modeling **Software:** Blender **Budget:** Negotiable ### Project Description I am looking for an experienced 3D artist to recreate a futuristic spherical robot from a supplied reference image with the highest possible accuracy. The model must closely match the reference in terms of proportions, shape, mechanical construction, armor panels, colors, materials, and fine details. I am not looking for a redesign or creative interpretation. ### 3D Modeling Requirements - Highly accurate recreation of the supplied reference. - Clean, professional hard-surface geometry. - Detailed spherical body with segmented armor. - Individually modeled armor panels. - Separate mechanical thruster components. - Separate face screen, eyes, and mouth. - Accurate mechanical connections and surface detailing. - High-quality materials and textures. ### Important: Editable Component Structure The entire model must be fully editable and organized into clearly named Blender Collections and separate objects. I must be able to independently: - Change individual armor panels. - Modify armor colors and materials. - Replace or modify the eyes and facial expressions. - Change thruster components. - Modify mechanical details. - Add or remove accessories. - Hide, replace, or customize components without affecting the rest of the model. Please avoid permanently joining independent components into a single mesh. ### Required Deliverables 1. Complete editable Blender `.blend` source project. 2. Individual mesh components organized into Collections. 3. FBX export with separate mesh components. 4. UV mapping and editable PBR materials. 5. All associated texture files. 6. Front, rear, left, right, top, and bottom orthographic renders. 7. Three-quarter perspective render matching the supplied reference. 8. Wireframe screenshots showing mesh construction. ### Additional Requirements - The model must use consistent dimensions, origins, and alignment. - Components must remain independently editable. - All source files must be included. - Full commercial usage rights and assignment of the agreed intellectual property rights are required. - The work and supplied reference must remain confidential and cannot be published or shared without written permission. **No animation or rigging required.** ### When Applying Please share examples of your previous hard-surface 3D modeling work, especially mechanical robots or sci-fi designs. I will prioritize accuracy, clean geometry, and proper Blender project organization over rendering effects.

opportunities.verbatim_request: "# Hiring: Expert Blender 3D Artist – Accurate Hard-Surface Robot Modeling **Project Type:** Fixed-price 3D modeling **Software:** Blender **Budget:** Negotiable ### Project Description I am looking for an experienced 3D artist to recreate a futuristic spherical robot from a supplied reference image with the highest possible accuracy. The model must closely match the reference in terms of proportions, shape, mechanical construction, armor panels, colors, materials, and fine details. I am not looking for a redesign or creative interpretation. ### 3D Modeling Requirements - Highly accurate recreation of the supplied reference. - Clean, professional hard-surface geometry. - Detailed spherical body with segmented armor. - Individually modeled armor panels. - Separate mechanical thruster components. - Separate face screen, eyes, and mouth. - Accurate mechanical connections and surface detailing. - High-quality materials and textures. ### Important: Editable Component Structure The entire model must be fully editable and organized into clearly named Blender Collections and separate objects. I must be able to independently: - Change individual armor panels. - Modify armor colors and materials. - Replace or modify the eyes and facial expressions. - Change thruster components. - Modify mechanical details. - Add or remove accessories. - Hide, replace, or customize components without affecting the rest of the model. Please avoid permanently joining independent components into a single mesh. ### Required Deliverables 1. Complete editable Blender `.blend` source project. 2. Individual mesh components organized into Collections. 3. FBX export with separate mesh components. 4. UV mapping and editable PBR materials. 5. All associated texture files. 6. Front, rear, left, right, top, and bottom orthographic renders. 7. Three-quarter perspective render matching the supplied reference. 8. Wireframe screenshots showing mesh construction. ### Additional Requirements - The model must use consistent dimensions, origins, and alignment. - Components must remain independently editable. - All source files must be included. - Full commercial usage rights and assignment of the agreed intellectual property rights are required. - The work and supplied reference must remain confidential and cannot be published or shared without written permission. **No animation or rigging required.** ### When Applying Please share examples of your previous hard-surface 3D modeling work, especially mechanical robots or sci-fi designs. I will prioritize accuracy, clean geometry, and proper Blender project organization over rendering effects."

opportunities.title: Travel with ismail
opportunities.description: I run a Moroccan tourism agency that specialises in desert and adventure tours, and I need a clean, engaging website that lets visitors explore our itineraries and reach me easily. The site’s core job is simple: present each tour with photos, highlights, pricing, and a clear “Contact Us” or WhatsApp call-to-action so potential guests can ask questions or request a quote. A fast, mobile-first build is essential because many of our travellers research on their phones while already on the road. I’d like a straightforward CMS—WordPress, Webflow or another user-friendly platform—so I can add new trips or update dates without coding. Multilingual support (English first, with room to add French or Spanish later) will be a bonus, as will basic on-page SEO for “Morocco desert tour,” “Merzouga camel trek,” and similar phrases. Deliverables • Responsive website (home, tours listing, single-tour page, about, contact) • Contact form plus clickable phone/WhatsApp links • Easy-to-update CMS backend with clear instructions • Photo gallery integration and location map for each tour • Light branding to match our colours and desert imagery Once the site is live, I may explore adding online booking and payment, but for now viewing tours and contacting me is enough. If this sounds like a build you can turn around quickly and elegantly, let’s talk.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40807371, publicado hace 3 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 500 - 1,000.

opportunities.title: BetBurger Automated Betting Integration
opportunities.description: # Automated Sports Betting Bot – BetBurger Integration Hi! I'm looking for an experienced developer specializing in browser automation and bot development to **build an automated sports betting bot from scratch, using selections from BetBurger**. I'd like to explain how the system should work and the main requirements of the project. ### 1. Project Objective My goal is to develop a system that **automatically reads the betting selections displayed on BetBurger and places the corresponding bets at the relevant bookmakers**, without requiring manual intervention. I use approximately **10–15 different bookmakers**, including LeoVegas, Paf, SpeedyBet, GoldenBull, Winamax, 888, Betway, and others. **I will personally configure BetBurger**, including all the filters, criteria, and betting opportunities I want to see. The bot doesn't need to find betting opportunities on its own or decide which bets are worth placing. Its only job is to detect the selections displayed on BetBurger and execute those bets automatically, quickly, and reliably. ### 2. Bot Functionality The system should be able to: - Automatically read the betting selections displayed on BetBurger. - Identify the bookmaker, sporting event, betting market, selection, and odds. - Access the corresponding bookmaker's website. - Automatically search for and locate the correct match or sporting event. - Find the specified betting market and selection. - Verify that the available odds are still acceptable. - Add the selection to the betslip. - Enter the corresponding stake. - Automatically confirm the bet when all the required conditions are met. - Detect errors, odds changes, suspended markets, or rejected bets. - Record the outcome of each operation. ### 3. BetBurger Integration A fundamental part of the project is ensuring that the bot can automatically and reliably read the selections displayed on BetBurger. The ideal workflow would be: 1. BetBurger displays a betting selection based on the filters I've already configured. 2. The bot detects the selection and extracts the necessary information. 3. It identifies the corresponding bookmaker. 4. It searches for the event and betting market. 5. It verifies that the bet is still available under the required conditions. 6. It automatically places the bet. 7. It records the result and moves on to the next selection. If multiple selections appear, **the bot does not need to place bets simultaneously**. It can process them **one at a time**, completing each operation before moving on to the next. The important thing is that the process is sufficiently fast and reliable. ### 4. Technical Approach and Environment I don't have any strict preferences regarding the technologies or tools used. I'm open to whichever technical solution you consider most appropriate, as long as the system works reliably. I also don't mind if the bot switches between browser tabs, uses automated mouse and keyboard interactions, or processes bets sequentially. You would have the freedom to choose the architecture and technologies you believe are best suited to the project. ### 5. Anti-Bot Detection and Human-Like Behavior **This is one of the most important requirements of the project.** Bookmakers use different systems to detect automated activity, so I'm looking for someone with experience working with websites that have anti-bot protection. I would like the system to: - Behave as similarly as possible to a real human user when navigating websites. - Interact with pages naturally, avoiding excessively mechanical or repetitive patterns. - Operate reliably on websites with anti-bot protection systems. - Minimize the risk of detection, account restrictions, or interruptions caused by automation. - Properly handle errors and security verification challenges. - Maintain consistent performance over extended periods. I'm particularly interested in a developer who has previously worked on automation projects involving websites with advanced bot detection systems. I'd also appreciate an explanation of any potential limitations and the technical solutions you would recommend. ### 6. Speed, Stability, and Reliability Speed is important because many BetBurger selections involve live sports betting, where odds can change very quickly. The bot should: - Detect selections with minimal delay. - Quickly locate the corresponding events and betting markets. - Verify the available odds before confirming a bet. - Skip selections when the odds no longer meet the requirements. - Prevent duplicate bets on the same selection. - Detect errors and recover from them whenever possible. - Maintain a log of successfully placed bets and failed attempts. - Operate autonomously for extended periods. The bot doesn't necessarily need to handle multiple bets at the same time. I'd prefer a system that reliably processes one bet after another rather than a more complex system that is less stable. ### 7. Questions Before Getting Started I'd like to know: 1. Have you worked on similar projects before, particularly sports betting bots or browser automation systems? 2. How would you approach this project from a technical perspective, and which technologies would you use? 3. Do you have experience working with anti-bot protection systems and automation designed to mimic human behavior? 4. What would your approximate development cost be? Would it be possible to divide the project into two stages? **My idea is to divide the development into two stages:** - **Stage 1:** Build a fully functional version that reads selections from BetBurger and automatically places bets at a single bookmaker. I'd like to verify that the system works properly, with good speed, stability, and reliability, before moving forward. - **Stage 2:** If the first version works well and meets all the requirements, we would gradually expand the system to support the remaining 10–15 bookmakers. I'd appreciate a separate quote for the first stage and a rough cost estimate for the second stage. **The budget is flexible, and I'm open to negotiating the price depending on your experience, proposed technical approach, and the scope of the work.** I'm looking for a skilled and reliable developer with whom I could potentially build a long-term working relationship, while keeping development and maintenance costs reasonable. Thank you!

opportunities.title: USA/UK B2B Tech Sales Partners
opportunities.description: # International Client Acquisition Partner (USA & UK) ### Commission-Only | B2B Technology | Long-Term Partnership Briquicks Technologies is an India-based technology company looking to expand its presence in the United States and United Kingdom. We are seeking experienced, self-employed business development professionals based in the USA or UK who can help us acquire international clients and establish long-term business relationships. ## About Briquicks Technologies We specialise in delivering technology solutions to businesses, including: - Artificial Intelligence (AI) Automation - AI Agents, Voice Agents and Chatbots - Custom Software Development - SaaS Application Development - Web and Mobile Application Development - Shopify and E-commerce Solutions - Business Process Automation - Digital Transformation and Technology Consulting Website: https://www.briquicks.com/ ## Responsibilities - Identify and acquire potential business clients in the USA and UK. - Generate and qualify B2B leads, particularly among SMEs and startups. - Conduct outreach through LinkedIn, email and professional networks. - Connect with business owners, founders and decision-makers. - Identify business requirements and present relevant technology solutions. - Manage sales opportunities and convert prospects into paying clients. - Build and maintain long-term client relationships. ## Compensation and Collaboration Model This is an independent business partnership, not a salaried employment position. - Commission: 10%–30% per successfully closed deal. - Uncapped earning potential. - No fixed salary or monthly retainer. - No upfront marketing or operational fees. - Commission calculated on actual revenue collected from clients introduced and acquired by the partner. - Opportunity for long-term collaboration and revenue-sharing arrangements. Commission percentages will be mutually agreed upon based on deal size, contribution and responsibilities. ## Ideal Candidate - Currently based in the United States or United Kingdom. - Self-employed business development professional, independent sales consultant or entrepreneur. - Proven experience in B2B sales and client acquisition. - Experience selling IT services, AI solutions, software development or digital transformation services is preferred. - Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills. - Ability to independently identify opportunities and engage decision-makers. - Commercially driven and interested in long-term business partnerships. ## How the Partnership Works The Client Acquisition Partner will focus on identifying opportunities, generating leads, managing initial client engagement and driving sales conversions. Briquicks Technologies will provide technical consultation, solution design, software development, project execution, technical resources and delivery management. Both parties will work together to establish profitable and sustainable client relationships. ## How to Apply Interested professionals are requested to share: 1. Full name and current location. 2. LinkedIn profile. 3. Previous B2B sales and business development experience. 4. Industries and services previously sold. 5. Examples of successful client acquisitions, where available. 6. Preferred commission and collaboration structure. We are interested in building a long-term partnership with the right people. Website: https://www.briquicks.com/

opportunities.title: Revit Residence Model & Views
opportunities.description: My submission deadline is racing toward me, and I have only the ground- and first-floor layouts of a small residence sketched by hand. The drawings show room sizes, dimensions, and every door and window, but I still need the full digital package: a complete Autodesk Revit model that automatically spits out clean sections, elevations, and presentation-ready 3D views. You will receive high-resolution scans of the two floor plans the moment we start. From those images, I need you to rebuild the house faithfully in Revit, assign correct levels, walls, doors, windows, floors, and a simple roof, then let the software generate the orthographic sheets. Keep the detailing basic—structure and openings are enough—as the main goal is to demonstrate technical comprehension, not interior styling. Deliverables (all required for submission) • Native .rvt file with the fully modelled residence • Two longitudinal and two cross sections placed on sheets • All principal elevations on sheets • At least three high-resolution 3D views (axonometric or perspective) exported as JPEG/PNG • PDFs of every sheet for quick printing Accuracy to the given dimensions is critical; everything must line up with the sketches. A short walkthrough video or screen-record showing the model is a plus but not mandatory. I’m happy to answer questions quickly because time is short. Let me know your turnaround and any clarifications you need, and we can get started right away.

opportunities.title: Website Company Profile Modern Responsif
opportunities.description: Oke, ini deskripsi yang udah bagus dan masuk akal, tinggal copy-paste ke Freelancer. Ini aku bikinin yang umum biar gampang diedit: --- *Judul Proyek: Pembuatan Website Company Profile yang Modern dan Responsif* *Deskripsi Proyek:* Saya membutuhkan freelancer untuk membuat website company profile yang profesional, cepat, dan mudah digunakan di HP maupun laptop. Website ini akan digunakan untuk memperkenalkan bisnis, menampilkan produk/layanan, dan memudahkan calon pelanggan untuk menghubungi kami via WhatsApp. *Fitur yang Dibutuhkan:* 1. Halaman Utama (Home) dengan desain modern dan menarik 2. Halaman Tentang Kami, Layanan/Produk, Galeri/Portofolio, dan Kontak 3. Tombol WhatsApp mengambang & Form kontak 4. Desain responsif (nyaman dibuka di HP, tablet, dan laptop) 5. SEO dasar agar mudah ditemukan di Google 6. Kecepatan loading cepat & keamanan dasar (SSL) *Teknologi yang Diutamakan:* WordPress / HTML, CSS, JavaScript, atau Laravel (bisa disesuaikan dengan keahlian freelancer) *Yang Saya Harapkan dari Freelancer:* - Memberikan contoh portofolio website yang pernah dibuat - Mengerjakan revisi minor hingga website sesuai ekspektasi - Memberikan panduan singkat cara mengelola website / update konten - Menyelesaikan proyek tepat waktu dan komunikatif *Deadline:* 7 - 14 hari setelah proyek dimulai *Budget:* Bisa didiskusikan sesuai dengan penawaran dan kualitas portofolio Silakan ajukan penawaran beserta estimasi waktu pengerjaan dan contoh hasil kerja Anda. Terima kasih. --- Mau aku sesuaikan ke jenis website apa? - Toko online / e-commerce - Website sekolah / organisasi - Website portfolio pribadi - Website jasa / landing page Kasih tau aja jenisnya, nanti aku rapihin lagi deskripsinya biar lebih pas.

opportunities.title: Numeric CAPTCHA Entry Project
opportunities.description: The task is simple but demands precision: I will supply batches of images that each contain a single numeric CAPTCHA. Every code must be keyed in exactly as shown, one image after the other, without the aid of OCR or automation. You’ll receive the images through a shared Google Drive folder, email, or direct site access—whichever proves fastest once we begin. Completed work can come back as a plain .txt file, a CSV/Excel sheet, or be entered straight into the target website; we’ll lock down the format together before the first batch goes out. Turnaround matters nearly as much as accuracy. For each batch, aim for a 24-hour return window while maintaining at least 99 % correctness. I’ll spot-check the submissions, and any line that fails validation will need a quick correction. Only digits appear in these CAPTCHAs, so no concerns about case sensitivity or special characters. Make sure your workflow keeps the original image order intact so reconciliation is painless. When you reply, share: • Your average typing speed for numeric CAPTCHAs (images per hour). • The time zone you’ll be working from for smooth scheduling. • Any prior experience with high-volume data entry, Google Sheets, or Excel. Once we agree on the process, I’ll release the first batch right away and we can keep scaling from there.

opportunities.title: Google Ads for Food Delivery
opportunities.description: I run a food-delivery brand and I’m ready to scale. The goal is clear: Get more food orders through my website or app and generate more phone and WhatsApp orders at the same time. I want carefully structured Google Ads campaigns that target several nearby cities or neighborhoods, showing hungry customers our best-selling meals and popular dishes right when they search. Here is what I need from you: • Audit or set up the Google Ads account from scratch, including proper conversion tracking for online check-outs, click-to-call, and WhatsApp. • Build search, display, and if useful, discovery campaigns focused on “Best-selling meals and popular dishes,” using ad extensions that highlight price, ratings, and delivery times. • Fine-tune location targeting so the ads appear only in the selected nearby areas, adjusting bids by distance and time of day to maximize order volume. • Ongoing optimization—keywords, negatives, ad copy, and bid strategy—to keep cost per order in check while scaling volume. • Concise weekly reports that show orders, calls, spend, and ROAS, plus clear next-step recommendations. I’ll supply high-res food photos, current menu links, and any promo codes you’d like to test. If you have proven experience driving profitable orders for restaurants or delivery services with Google Ads, let’s talk strategy and launch right away.

opportunities.title: Admin Online Chat Pelanggan
opportunities.description: Pekerjaan ini berfokus pada pembalasan chat pelanggan berbahasa Indonesia untuk toko online saya. opportunities.title: High-Impact Social Promo Video Edits
opportunities.description: I’m producing a series of short promotional clips that will live on Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube Shorts, and I need them to look and feel premium. Each video must instantly sell the product while keeping viewers engaged to the final frame. Here’s what I’m after: clean cuts, smooth yet energetic transitions, eye-catching motion graphics, on-brand typography, and a balanced sound mix. I’ll supply raw footage, brand guidelines, product images, and any copy needed; you transform that material into scroll-stopping content that feels native to each platform’s style limits and aspect ratios. Deliverables • Final videos in vertical format (1080 × 1920), ready for direct upload to Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, and YouTube Shorts • An exported teaser thumbnail for each clip • Project files (Premiere Pro / After Effects or equivalent) neatly organised so my in-house team can make minor tweaks later Acceptance Criteria 1. Visual flow matches the reference pace I’ll share (≈15–30 seconds per clip). 2. Brand colours and fonts are applied consistently. 3. Motion graphics highlight key product benefits within the first 5 seconds. 4. No artefacts, abrupt cuts, or audio pops in the final render. 5. All files delivered by the agreed deadline. If you thrive on impactful social storytelling and can keep a tight turnaround, let’s talk and lock in the first batch.

opportunities.title: Telegram Crypto Escrow Bot - 07/11/2026 02:50 EST
opportunities.description: I need a Telegram bot that acts as a secure escrow for peer-to-peer deals. Its only job is to handle transactions, and those transactions will be in cryptocurrency. The bot must accept deposits in Litecoin as well as USDT on the BEP-20, TRC-20 and ERC-20 networks, hold the funds safely, then release or refund them when both parties (or a moderator) give the appropriate command. Core flow: a buyer or seller calls /startescrow, the bot supplies deposit addresses, tracks on-chain confirmations, locks the funds, and waits for /release or /cancel. opportunities.title: Scale Celvane’s D2C E-Commerce Growth
opportunities.description: Project Title: E-Commerce Growth Strategist & Performance Marketer to Scale Celvane to ₹5 Lakhs/Month (Prepaid + COD) Project Overview: Celvane (fashion & lifestyle brand) is looking for an experienced e-commerce growth strategist and media buyer to build, launch, and optimize our acquisition funnel to reach ₹5,00,000 in monthly gross merchandise value (GMV) with a balanced 50% Prepaid / 50% COD split. Key Deliverables: 1. Store Conversion & Checkout Optimization: - Audit and optimize the storefront (Shopify/lightweight stack) for maximum mobile conversion rate (target: 2.5%+). - Integrate an Indian payment gateway (Razorpay/Cashfree) with 1-click UPI checkout. - Configure COD verification and risk filters (OTP verification / automated WhatsApp confirmation) to restrict Return-to-Origin (RTO) below 20%. 2. Paid Customer Acquisition (Meta / Instagram Ads): - Build, launch, and manage Advantage+ Sales Campaigns on Meta. - Conduct creative testing for 10–15 short-form video hooks (Reels/UGC styling formats). - Maintain a minimum target blended ROAS of 3.0x to 3.5x. 3. Retention & Order Recovery Automation: - Set up automated WhatsApp sequences for abandoned carts and prepaid incentives (e.g., offering an instant ₹100 discount to convert COD orders into prepaid). - Implement post-purchase tracking updates to reduce delivery refusals. Requirements: - Proven track record scaling Indian D2C fashion or lifestyle brands to ₹5L+ monthly GMV. - Deep expertise in managing COD cash flow and mitigating RTO losses. - Please share live case studies or dashboard screenshots showing verified ROAS and ad spend. Budget & Structure: - Fixed monthly retainer + tiered performance bonus based on delivered net revenue milestones.

opportunities.title: Client Acquisition Executive for Web Projects
opportunities.description: Details In Short: We need an experienced commission-based Business Development / Client Acquisition Executive who can get us new clients. Duration: 1 month to 1.5 month (15 nov - 31 dec) Budget 10,000rs (In milestones, 2000rs per converted client, converted client project value should be above 5000rs) Target: 5 paying clients. Payment will be released in milestones, one for each successful conversion. Prefered Freelancer: In Indian, who understand local language and demand, and how to talk to potential client, has done similar work before, deal with client in professional manner. Previous experience in sales, business development, lead generation or client acquisition is preferred. Languages: Hindi, english or both Target Locations: Mandsaur,MP Nimach, Manasa, Jaora, Ratlam, Targeted Clients: people who need portfolio websites, small business like beauty parlors, gyms, etc looking for their online presence, people who need website or an app. We are interested in businesses and individuals who need an online presence or digital solutions. Examples include: ⦁ Beauty parlours and salons. ⦁ Gyms and fitness centres. ⦁ Restaurants and cafes. ⦁ Local shops and small businesses. ⦁ Professionals who need portfolio/personal websites. ⦁ Businesses looking for website development. ⦁ Individuals or businesses requiring custom applications. Responsibilities ⦁ Research and identify potential clients. ⦁ Find businesses through Google Maps, social media and other platforms. ⦁ Contact potential clients through calls, WhatsApp, social media or cold emails. ⦁ Understand their business requirements and identify opportunities. ⦁ Present our website and application development services. ⦁ Explain the proposed solution and communicate with potential customers. ⦁ Follow up with interested prospects and handle initial negotiations. ⦁ Convert interested prospects into confirmed paying clients. We will provide the necessary service details, pricing information and proposals to help you pitch our services. What you will do: 1. find potential clients. 2. reach them. 3. understand their business and give details to me. 4. I'll make demo screens and details and send to you. 4. pitch them offer and shows demo 5. Payment is done after they agree to make full project with us 6. Keep track in spreedsheet of Businesses contacted, Interested prospects, Meetings, discussions arranged, Proposals sent, Paying clients acquired. Definition of a Successful Conversion A client will be considered successfully converted when ⦁ The client agrees to proceed with a development project. ⦁ The project requirements and pricing are confirmed. repeat the process for 5 clients.

Standard PLA or TPU is not suitable for this purpose. Please let me know about your direct experience printing silicone or other soft-touch elastomers, the hardware you’ll be using, and any post-processing you provide (e.g., curing, trimming, surface finishing). If shipping is required, I’m in the [provide your location] region; factor that into your turnaround so we can hit the “within a month” window. Deliverable: one fully cured, production-quality massage bar prototype that matches the supplied STL exactly.

opportunities.title: 2D Human Sprite Walk & Crawl
opportunities.description: I already have a rough concept for a human-style 2D character and now I need all of the movement animations brought to life directly inside Blender. The focus is simple: a complete set of walk cycles in every cardinal and diagonal direction, plus matching crawl cycles in those same directions. No extra attacks or idles—just fluid, game-ready locomotion. What I expect from you • A clean Blender file containing the rig and finished animations. • Exported PNG sprite sheets (or individual frames, if you prefer) for each direction of both the walk and crawl cycles, ready to drop into my engine. • Consistent frame counts and timing across every direction so I can swap animations without hiccups. I’ll supply the character reference, palette, and exact frame size once we start. If you’ve handled multi-direction 2D rigs in Blender before, this should be a straightforward assignment. Looking forward to seeing the character finally move!

opportunities.title: AI Bot development issues
opportunities.description: I'm developing an AI bot for private use and need to refine its design and user experience. Key improvements needed: - Streamlining the bot's functionality for efficiency - Enhancing overall design for better usability **Title: cTrader C# Developer Needed to Audit and Align an Adaptive Demo and Live Trading Bot** I’m looking for an experienced cTrader Automate/C# developer to investigate and fix differences between my cloud demo bot and local live-account bot. The project is **Jye Gold V8 Adaptive**, currently used for **XAUUSD on five-minute candles with Pepperstone**. I have the existing source code, compiled builds, parameter exports, journals, test results and saved local learning checkpoints. **The main problem** The demo and live versions were intended to use the same adaptive strategy, with the additional account permissions needed for live trading. In practice, their behaviour and results have differed. The live bot has sometimes opened and closed trades within seconds, including taking very small profits or losses. Logs show that some of these exits came from the model deciding its expected edge had faded or reversed, rather than the trailing stop being hit. I need the developer to establish whether those decisions are correct, whether the forecasts are being applied consistently, and why the demo behaves differently. **What has already been identified** - The demo and live instances have separate learned model states. Copying the strategy code and parameters did not transfer the demo’s accumulated learning. - An earlier exit-buffer change was applied only to the live version. That change was subsequently removed, and the latest live candidate’s decision engine was matched to the demo engine and checked with replay tests. - Other repairs have addressed quote changes during saving that cancelled entry attempts, a delayed trade-closure/checkpoint issue, and position ownership problems caused by shared labels between bot copies. - Local learning restoration has been implemented and observed working through restarts of the same instance. - The cloud demo’s model is currently held in memory for that run. A verified export and durable recovery mechanism for its exact learned state remains unresolved. These are the recorded findings so far. I want the current installed versions and native logs audited, rather than assuming every earlier issue is still present or that all repairs are fully proven. **What I need done** 1. Compare the actual demo and live builds, parameters, model states and execution paths. 2. Reproduce the rapid exits and explain the precise entry and exit decisions, including conflicting short- and longer-horizon forecasts. 3. Check candle timing, tick updates, bid/ask prices, spread, commissions, slippage and execution delays. 4. Establish a reliable model-only export/import process where supported. Keep account-specific positions, orders and ownership records separate. 5. Verify restart recovery, duplicate-order prevention and isolation between multiple instances. 6. Preserve the intended stop-loss, trailing-stop and sizing behaviour. Any strategy changes should be clearly explained and tested against the baseline. 7. Reconcile results using this bot’s confirmed trades and net results after costs, separately from manual trades and unrelated account history. **Deliverables** I want a clear root-cause report, corrected source and compiled package, a documented list of changes, and reproducible test evidence. Given identical model state and market inputs, the strategy decisions should match; genuine broker/execution differences should be explained. Initial testing should use simulation or demo. Live activation will remain under my control. Please include your relevant cTrader/C# experience, how you would investigate this, and separate estimates for the initial audit and subsequent fixes. I’m looking for reliable, measurable engineering work—not a promise of guaranteed profits. Source code and redacted supporting records can be provided privately. Ideal Skills and Experience: - Expertise in AI bot design - Strong background in UX/UI design - Experience in optimizing bot interactions Looking for a freelancer who can ensure my AI bot is user-friendly and visually appealing. It’s currently demo trial has had great results but the live trial seems to be not working the same the project has been developed with chat gpt and vis code on ctrader platform

opportunities.description: Necesito un profesional que desarrolle el paquete completo de planos para una casa de una sola planta en un terreno inferior a 150 m². Requiero que el juego incluya: • Arquitectura: plantas, cortes, fachadas y cuadro de áreas • Estructura: cimentación, detalles de losas, vigas y columnas, con memorias de cálculo básicas • Instalaciones: esquemas y planos de electricidad, hidráulica y sanitaria con su respectiva simbología Entrego el programa de necesidades y las medidas exactas del predio una vez iniciado el trabajo; espero retroalimentación sobre distribución y soluciones constructivas antes de cerrar la versión final. opportunities.title: Campaña Afiliados Servicios Funerarios Chile
opportunities.description: Estamos buscando traffickers digitales, especialistas en performance marketing y afiliados independientes que quieran generar ingresos mediante la captación de clientes interesados en servicios de cementerio, funerarios, cremación y sepulturas. Buscamos personas o agencias con experiencia en campañas digitales, generación de leads calificados y adquisición de clientes, que puedan desarrollar estrategias comerciales orientadas a resultados. Canales de adquisición: * Meta Ads: Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads y campañas de generación de leads. * Google Ads: Search, Performance Max, Display y YouTube Ads. * TikTok Ads: campañas de captación y generación de demanda. * SEO y posicionamiento orgánico: captación de clientes mediante búsquedas de alta intención. * WhatsApp Marketing: estrategias de conversión y derivación de prospectos. * Email Marketing y automatizaciones: captación, remarketing y recuperación de oportunidades. * Marketing de afiliados: redes de referidos, sitios web, comunidades digitales y plataformas de generación de demanda. ¿Qué buscamos? Personas con experiencia en adquisición digital que puedan gestionar sus propias campañas, identificar oportunidades comerciales y generar prospectos con intención real de contratación. El modelo de colaboración estará orientado a resultados, con comisiones por ventas efectivamente concretadas, según el producto y las condiciones comerciales acordadas. ¿Qué ofrecemos? * Oportunidad de generar ingresos mediante comisiones por ventas. * Portafolio de servicios con demanda permanente. * Posibilidad de colaboración comercial de largo plazo. * Modelo de trabajo flexible e independiente. * Potencial de crecimiento según resultados y volumen de ventas. ¿Te interesa participar? Si tienes experiencia gestionando campañas en Google Ads, Meta Ads u otros canales de adquisición y buscas monetizar tus habilidades en marketing digital, queremos conocerte. Escríbenos indicando tu experiencia, canales que gestionas, volumen de leads que puedes generar y modalidad de trabajo. ¡Buscamos aliados estratégicos para potenciar la generación de demanda y nuevas oportunidades comerciales!

opportunities.title: Layout PCB vi điều khiển
opportunities.description: Tôi đang hoàn thiện một mạch điều khiển dùng vi điều khiển; sơ đồ nguyên lý đã xong nhưng danh sách linh kiện vẫn còn vài vị trí cần chốt. Board phải đọc cảm biến, điều khiển relay hoặc động cơ, có kết nối không dây (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth hoặc 4G) và hiển thị trạng thái qua màn hình, nút bấm cùng đèn báo. Những gì tôi cần từ bạn: • Kiểm tra lại schematic hiện tại, đề xuất hoặc xác nhận linh kiện trước khi sang bước layout. • Bố trí và định tuyến PCB tối ưu (2–4 layer tuỳ đề xuất) bảo đảm: – vùng RF sạch cho module không dây, – đường công suất đủ rộng cho relay/motor, – cách ly nhiễu tốt cho khối cảm biến. • Giao bộ file hoàn chỉnh: file thiết kế (Altium hoặc KiCad), Gerber/NC Drill sẵn sàng sản xuất, BOM cập nhật, bản PDF/3D preview và vị trí test-point gợi ý. • Hướng dẫn ngắn về lắp ráp và kiểm thử để tôi chuyển tiếp cho xưởng. Bạn từng layout board tích hợp không dây và tải công suất nhỏ sẽ là lợi thế lớn. Vui lòng kèm vài dự án tương tự và thời gian hoàn thành dự kiến khi gửi đề xuất.

opportunities.title: Round Perfume Bottle CAD Design
opportunities.description: I’m creating a new luxury fragrance line and need a production-ready CAD model for its signature perfume bottle. The vision is distinctly round or softly curved to feel elegant in the hand, with a bespoke cap that complements the silhouette. Here’s what I’m looking for: • A fully detailed 3D CAD file (STEP or IGES preferred) of the bottle and custom cap, ready for mould tooling. • Basic engineering drawings with overall dimensions, wall thickness recommendations, and parting lines indicated. • A few photorealistic renders that show how the glass and cap will look in clear, frosted, and tinted finishes so I can share visuals with branding and marketing. You’re free to choose the platform that suits you best—SolidWorks, Rhino, Fusion 360, or similar—as long as the output is clean and manufacturable. If you’ve designed fragrance or cosmetics packaging before, please mention it; experience with glass tolerances and cap fitment is a big plus. Once awarded, I’ll supply logo artwork, target fill volume, and any regulatory marks that need to sit on the base. I’d like to review an initial concept within a few days, iterate once or twice, and then receive the final files. Looking forward to seeing your design skills bring this luxury bottle to life.

opportunities.title: Santa Reindeer Flight Animation & Textures
opportunities.description: Hi! I have a Santa with sleigh and reindeer scene, I need animation and textures converted. Looking for one person to tackle both issues in a single pass, and to work with long term as go-to 3D specialist. • Animation Create a smooth, simple, seamless, loopable “flying through the sky” cycle—Santa in the sleigh, reins tight, reindeer legs pumping and bodies bobbing naturally. Animations must follow certain criteria that I require. • Texture conversion Currently the textures use a legacy/non-PBR work flow, including spec/reflection maps. I need the textures converted into standard PBR workflow with ORM maps and renamed as required. Deliverables – Clean .max file with the new animation applied – All converted textures, neatly organized and linked – A quick viewport or playblast preview so I can review timing before final hand-off Acceptance criteria 1. The flight loop plays endlessly without visible pops or foot-slide. 2. Opening the .max file triggers zero missing-map warnings. 3. File paths are relative so the project relocates without breaking. If you’re comfortable animating characters and fixing PBR/legacy texture inside 3ds Max, this should be a easy, straightforward, fun task. Looking to get this completed ASAP, ready to chat more to provide reference and further detail. Thanks!

opportunities.title: Smooth Logo Animation Variations
opportunities.description: I already have the finished logo artwork as a PNG and now need it brought to life. The goal is an about 8-second sequence with moving parts and smooth motion—clean, polished, and perfectly suited for use as the opener to my video intros and presentations. Deliverables • Animated logo in original colour on transparent/alpha • Same animation on a plain white background • Same animation on a plain black background • Preferred formats: 1920×1080 (or higher) MP4/H.264 for all three, plus a ProRes or MOV with alpha for the transparent version. The editable project file is a bonus. The animation should resolve by roughly the 6-second mark, then hold for the remaining couple of seconds so the logo is clearly visible before cutting away. Subtle sound design is welcome if you feel it enhances the piece, but it isn’t mandatory. Let me know which tool you’ll use—After Effects, Blender, or similar—and feel free to share a quick reel of past smooth-motion logo work so I can see your style. I’ll supply the logo in vector and high-res PNG the moment we start. Looking forward to seeing it in motion!

Let me know which tool you’ll use—After Effects, Blender, or similar—and feel free to share a quick reel of past smooth-motion logo work so I can see your style. I’ll supply the logo in vector and high-res PNG the moment we start. Looking forward to seeing it in motion!"

opportunities.title: Especialista en Ethical hacking y Blindaje de VPS
opportunities.description: Estamos buscando un ingeniero senior en ciberseguridad y hacking ético de habla hispana (preferiblemente ubicado en España o franja horaria compatible) con un fuerte perfil de ingeniería de sistemas y mentalidad de agencia. Actualmente gestionamos una infraestructura crítica en un servidor VPS que aloja 17 aplicaciones dockerizadas, páginas web con wordpress, html y Astro, además de flujos de automatización en n8n. Requerimos un profesional con experiencia real y contrastada para auditar, blindar y establecer un sistema de monitorización y recuperación ante desastres continuo. Aviso importante: No leemos propuestas automáticas ni generadas por IA. Si aplicas, por favor detalla brevemente un caso real donde hayas solucionado un incidente crítico o securizado un entorno de múltiples contenedores Docker en producción. "Empieza tu mensaje con la palabra 'CIBER-2026'". Fase 1: Alcance del Desarrollo Inicial - Hardening Integral de Servidor y Contenedores: Blindaje de Linux (baseline CIS), políticas de red, gestión segura de secretos, permisos de sockets de Docker y aislamiento de los 17 contenedores activos en el VPS. - Backup escalado del servidor con s3 para una recuperación en caso de infección o ataque. - Configuración de cloudflare. - Auditoría de Aplicaciones (Generadas por IA y Web): Revisión de vulnerabilidades lógicas, validación de OWASP Top 10 y revisión de código/APIs en las apps alojadas. - Arquitectura de Resiliencia y Disaster Recovery: Diseño e implementación de un sistema de copias de seguridad automatizadas, cifradas y probadas (política 3-2-1) con capacidad de recuperación inmediata (RTO/RPO mínimo) ante caídas o ataques. - Monitorización y Alertas de Intrusión (SIEM/IDS básico): Configuración de observabilidad en tiempo real ante accesos no autorizados, anomalías de recursos o intentos de vulneración (Fail2ban, logs centralizados y alertas por webhook). - Optimización de n8n: Recomendación técnica y reestructuración de las automatizaciones de n8n para garantizar aislamiento por cliente, rendimiento óptimo y escalabilidad de recursos en el VPS. Fase 2: Colaboración Continua (White-Label) Una vez blindado y estabilizado nuestro entorno interno, la relación evolucionará a un acuerdo a largo plazo donde el candidato actuará como nuestro partner técnico de ciberseguridad para clientes finales. Requerimos: - Su catálogo de servicios técnicos con precios netos de partner. - Su tarifa por hora como colaborador externo para incidencias o mantenimientos. - Tiempos de respuesta (SLA) y disponibilidad acordados. - Firmar un NDA o acuerdo de confidencialidad. - Disponibilidad de entrevista por videollamada antes de iniciar el proyecto. Requisitos Indispensables: - Habla hispana nativa (España o LATAM con excelente encaje horario). - Experiencia demostrable en seguridad ofensiva/defensiva, Linux avanzado, Docker, PostgreSQL y Nginx. - Transparencia, rigor técnico y capacidad para dar la cara de forma telemática ante clientes de la agencia. Para aplicar: Demuestra tu experiencia respondiendo directamente a nuestra arquitectura técnica actual y adjunta tus tarifas de partner.

opportunities.title: Edición Video Vertical Creativo
opportunities.description: Tengo varias grabaciones de videos hablando a cámara que necesito convertir en un contenido vertical pulido y listo para publicar en Instagram y TikTok. Te enviaré el material en bruto y espero que, con criterio editorial, construyas un video fluido: corta repeticiones y silencios, reorganiza las ideas para que mantengan coherencia y ajusta el ritmo para que el mensaje se entienda sin esfuerzo. El archivo final deberá incluir subtítulos incrustados con palabras clave grandes y animadas que resalten los conceptos centrales. También confío en ti para limpiar el audio, corregir color cuando sea necesario y dejar la pieza lista para usarse tal cual, en 1080 × 1920 px, preferiblemente en .mp4. Si tienes experiencia editando verticales para redes y dominas herramientas como Premiere Pro, Final Cut o DaVinci Resolve, envíame enlaces a trabajos similares, dime cuánta disponibilidad tienes y tu tarifa por este tipo de proyecto. Espero tu propuesta para empezar cuanto antes.

opportunities.title: Enhanced Facial Rig & Animation
opportunities.description: I have a fully modelled and generally well-rigged human character, but the face is letting the whole performance down. What I need now is a specialist who can breathe life into the facial rig so that it delivers convincing lip sync and the four key emotions—happy, sad, angry, and surprised—without the mesh collapsing or stretching unnaturally. The body controls, weights, and IK chains are already in good shape, so your attention can stay on the head: refining skin weights around the jaw, cheeks, and eyes; adding or polishing blend-shapes/shape keys for phonemes; and making sure the controls are intuitive enough for quick animation passes. Feel free to work in Maya, Blender, or any other mainstream package as long as you can hand back an FBX and the native file. I will supply: • The current rigged model (native file + FBX) • A short test audio clip for lip-sync evaluation • Turntable reference video of the existing deformation issues Deliver back to me: • Updated rig with clean, labeled facial controls • A short test animation that hits the supplied audio and shows all four emotions • Clear notes on anything I should know to keep the rig stable in production Acceptance criteria: • Jaw, lips, and cheeks follow audio naturally with no obvious mesh collapse • Happy, sad, angry, and surprised poses read clearly from every camera angle • No new skinning artifacts introduced elsewhere on the model If that sounds like your kind of challenge, let’s get started—I’m ready to drop the files to you right away.

opportunities.title: Redacción Técnica Ingeniería Química
opportunities.description: Busco apoyo en Ingeniería química escritorios o secretaria para redactar informes o documentos técnicos. Necesito que tomes la información que yo suministre (datos de proceso, fichas de equipos, parámetros de operación o normativa aplicable) y la transformes en reportes claros, bien estructurados y con lenguaje profesional, listos para presentar a gerencia y autoridades regulatorias. Alcance principal • Redactar y dar formato a los documentos técnicos según mis plantillas o, si lo prefieres, proponer un esquema de secciones lógico y coherente. • Verificar la consistencia de cifras, unidades y referencias bibliográficas. • Incluir tablas, diagramas simples o gráficos de datos cuando sean necesarios para respaldar los argumentos. • Entregar archivos editables (Word o equivalente) y versión PDF final. Valoraré experiencia previa elaborando reportes en ingeniería química, dominio de terminología específica y atención a los detalles de estilo y ortografía. Si manejas herramientas como MS Office, Google Workspace o software de diagramación básica (Visio, Lucidchart), menciónalo en tu propuesta. Indícame tu método de trabajo, plazos estimados y ejemplos de documentos similares que hayas preparado. Tengo material listo para comenzar en cuanto definamos el cronograma.

opportunities.title: Querétaro - Evaluar atención y servicio de manera presencial -- 7
opportunities.description: La actividad consiste en pedir información y solicitar una cotización de manera presencial en una empresa asignada por nosotros. Para realizar satisfactoriamente la actividad se requiere de lo siguiente: 1. Estudiar guía proporcionada por nosotros, comprender lo que se requiere mencionar y lo que se requiere cotizar, tener comunicación con nosotros por este medio antes de iniciar la actividad para aclarar el objetivo y resolver cualquier duda. (Tiempo aproximado 1 hora, de la cual son 30 minutos de estudio de guía y 30 minutos para resolver dudas). 2. Presentarse en la empresa y sucursal asignada para recibir explicación personal del servicio y confirmación de cotización. (Tiempo aproximado 30 minutos + el traslado) 5. Enviarnos la cotización recibida por correo electrónico y un formulario de evaluación (Tiempo aproximado 30-60 minutos). En total se requieren de 3 a 4 horas para completar la actividad, el pago es fijo y es de $50 USD una vez que la actividad fue completada satisfactoriamente. Requerimientos del Freelancer: A. Vivir en la ciudad de Querétaro. B. Contar con medio de transporte (auto o motocicleta). C. Edad mínima 25 años. D. Contar con un smartphone con Android y/o iOS y tener la app de Freelancer instalada en su teléfono móvil con las notificaciones activadas. (Una de las principales causas de que los proyectos no se logren satisfactoriamente es debido a que los Freelancers no están al pendiente de sus mensajes o no reciben las notificaciones causando una comunicación tardía, por este motivo te pedimos instalar la app y estar al tanto de la misma para beneficio de todos). Si te interesa participar en esta actividad y no has hecho la misma anteriormente realiza tu bid por la cantidad fija $50 USD y escribiendo en el mensaje el municipio en el que vives para confirmar que no eres un bot. Bids por cantidades mayores a $50 USD no serán considerados. Se contratarán varios shoppers para esta actividad. Gracias.
